def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str uses fs:
    """Return the text of the first file in names that can be read from the
    directory notes, or "" when none can. Only files inside notes are read: the
    body narrows fs with fs.sub("notes") before any read. Missing or unreadable
    files are skipped, and a name that escapes notes (for example "../x" or an
    absolute path) is treated as unreadable."""
    post out == "" or out.byte_len() > 0
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        for name in names:
            text = fs.read(name) else ""
            if text != "":
                return text
    return ""
